name: prefer-rollback-after-change
content: When a failure started right after a deploy or a configuration change, prefer rolling that change back over a forward fix.

name: no-restart-as-first-fix
content: Do not propose restarting pods as the first fix unless a recorded incident shows that a restart fixed the same failure.

name: cite-or-say-none
content: Every recommendation cites the past incident it is based on, or says plainly that no past incident matches.

name: blameless-postmortems
content: Postmortems are blameless: describe systems, signals and decisions; never name or blame individuals.
